scope: Historical source capture and coverage only; no strategy outcomes, account calls, orders or new spending
cell: One exchange session, all seven symbols except explicitly reused fixture symbols
end: Inclusive actual exchange close minus one second UTC
entity_mapping: Explicit asof=each session date; vendor underlying-entity mapping, not independently verified issuer ID, dated membership or information vintage

calendar.name: XNYS
calendar.provenance: Installed exchange_calendars US equity schedule with independently checked closure/early-close/DST anchors

transport.resume: Verify cached successful page bytes/parameters and continue next token; retain every failed/interrupted attempt; never refetch a successful page
transport.pagination: Continue until null token, independent of page row count; repeated token fails cell

coverage.all_minutes: Retain [open,close); exact closing-auction minute excluded; no claim equal to official daily OHLCV
checks: All seven symbol/session cells retained, including empty/error cells
Unique UTC minute starts and increasing per-symbol source order
Finite positive OHLC; low<=open,close<=high; nonnegative finite volume and integer trade count
Separate missing/invalid/duplicate/unaligned/out-of-window records; no fill, interpolation or invented bars
Report full-session and opening-hour coverage independently, plus exact10:46/12:46 source-bar presence
Every missing interval retained; absence can reflect no eligible trade, a halt or source failure, never automatically a vendor outage
Raw hashes, page tokens, request bounds/asof, response dates, captured times and all failures retained
coverage.qualification: Transport completion alone is not usable coverage. Later strategy must abstain on incomplete observed opening hours; entry/exit missingness must not screen earlier signals. No strategy PnL is computed here.

vintage_limits: Today-retrieved provider revisions, not historical publication timestamps
15-minute restriction plus processing latency implies opening hour cannot act before10:46ET; no real-time SIP entitlement assumed
Raw same-session units avoid overnight action returns; cross-session volume comparisons still require action-aware research declaration
Seven surviving names are purposive pilot, not broad historical membership
